newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,614 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,614 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,614 contracts compared with 5,261 overnight Sunday.
There were 1,558 wheat, 343 corn, 605 soybean, 59 soymeal, two soyoil, two oat, 38 wheat calls, two wheat puts, two corn puts and three soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was up 5-3/4 cents to down two cents, corn was down 1-1/4 to 1-3/4 cents and soybeans were two cents lower to one cent higher.
